title: Fictional correction revisions and review history
paragraphs: For this local fictional demonstration, I agree that my submitted answers and any corrected submissions may be reviewed by the designated chairperson, treasurer and secretary.

When changes are requested, I may edit only the requested answers and their required dependent answers, then resubmit the same registration. Earlier submitted answers, field-specific notes, decisions, reviewer attribution and server times remain in the private review history.

Approved or Rejected registrations cannot be reopened through this workflow. This does not verify identity, residency or eligibility. Retention, withdrawal and deletion procedures remain unresolved; use fictional information only.

Corrected family answers may include optional fictional sibling birthdates if supplied. Those dates and prior submitted revisions remain private review history; ages are recalculated using the server date in the Philippines. Full-section downloads require a separate explicit family/export scope acknowledgment.
checkbox: I agree to retain and share these fictional correction revisions and review history with the designated three staff reviewers.
